reference_sql:
WITH campaign_clicks AS (  -- one row per campaign with spend rows in the period
  SELECT c.channel_id, c.campaign_id, SUM(a.clicks) AS clicks
  FROM ad_spend_daily a
  JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  WHERE a.spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2025-10-31'
  GROUP BY c.channel_id, c.campaign_id
),
ranked AS (  -- one row per campaign, placed within its channel from the most clicks
  SELECT channel_id, campaign_id, clicks,
         RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY channel_id ORDER BY clicks DESC) AS click_rank
  FROM campaign_clicks
)
SELECT channel_id, campaign_id, clicks, click_rank
FROM ranked
WHERE click_rank <= 3

solver.query:
WITH camp AS (
  SELECT c.channel_id, s.campaign_id, SUM(s.clicks) AS clicks
  FROM ad_spend_daily s
  JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = s.campaign_id
  WHERE s.spend_date >= DATE '2025-07-01' AND s.spend_date <= DATE '2025-10-31'
  GROUP BY c.channel_id, s.campaign_id
), r AS (
  SELECT channel_id, campaign_id, clicks,
         RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY channel_id ORDER BY clicks DESC) AS click_rank
  FROM camp
)
SELECT channel_id, campaign_id, clicks, click_rank
FROM r
WHERE click_rank <= 3
